subject: Redlines: Order Form confidentiality + press/logo evidence escrow guidance
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudvista.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@cloudvista.com>, LegalOps <legal@cloudvista.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order form redlines + publicity clauses — what evidence do you need?

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — CloudVista is excited to move forward. Our procurement team has a couple of redlines on the Order Form / MSA around confidentiality and publicity. Specifically: 1) narrower publicity carveouts; 2) an escrow mechanism for logo use and press quotes (we need to understand what evidence you can provide); and 3) a limited data handling disclosure for marketing quotes.

Can you confirm what pieces of evidence Redwood can share (SOC2 summary, customer logo usage approval artifacts, approved one-line quotes) and whether you can accept our proposed publicity carveout where we require a 7-day notice and written approval before any public mention?

Attached is our latest OrderForm_v3 with inline comments. We want to finalize before sending to our legal team for countersignature.

Appreciate a quick runbook on next steps and who on your side will own the legal coordination.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, CloudVista

Attachments: CloudVista_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (docx, 45KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudvista.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + publicity clauses — what evidence do you need?

Thanks Sanjay — looping in Kimberly (legal) and Laura (marketing ops) to own the pieces. Quick answers up front:

- Evidence we can provide: redacted SOC2 report (we can share an excerpt), published case-study/quote templates, and a copy of our publicity approval flow; we cannot provide customer-specific attachments that violate other customers' NDAs.
- Publicity carveout: a 7-day notice + written approval is reasonable for marketing quotes; for logo use we usually require an approved asset and a short usage window in the Order Form.
- Escrow: we don't do escrow in the banking sense but we can provide an evidence bundle (signed approval emails, final approved asset PNG/SVG, and the quote text) to be stored with the contract folder.

Kimberly — can Legal confirm any mandatory language we need to push back on in the attached redlines? Laura — can you prepare the publicity evidence bundle checklist and template to send to CloudVista?

Markus
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

---
Attachment referenced: Redwood_Publicity_Guidelines_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudvista.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-13T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + publicity clauses — what evidence do you need?

Sanjay — thanks for sending the redlines. I reviewed the key points. Summary of legal position below, inline comments attached as a redline:

Main points:
1) Publicity / Quote approvals: Accept 7-day notice for quotes and press releases, provided Redwood retains right to approve assets and minimal edits to quotes for factual accuracy. We are okay with a written approval requirement (email is fine).
2) Logo use: Redwood requires a final approved asset and a usage spec (size/color/background). We will add a provision that the customer grants a non-exclusive, revocable license limited to the scope in the Order Form (publisher/marketing channels).
3) Escrow for evidence: We cannot agree to third-party escrow, but we will provide an evidence package (SOC2 excerpt, signed email approving quote, logo file) and retain that in our contract folder and in the CloudVista contract record in HubSpot.
4) Confidentiality / limited data disclosure: We will update the marketing quote clause so that any example or quote uses only non-sensitive content and that CloudVista confirms it has authority to permit the quote.

I attached a marked-up Order Form with explicit redlines where we cannot accept open-ended publicity carveouts. Please review and confirm the two items where we asked for specific language: (a) exact asset spec for logo, and (b) whether a separate publicity release or an approved email thread will satisfy written approval.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: CloudVista_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx (docx, 48KB)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudvista.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@cloudvista.com>, LegalOps <legal@cloudvista.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines + publicity clauses — what evidence do you need?

Kimberly — appreciate the clear redlines. Quick responses:

- Asset spec: we'll accept the usage spec added by Redwood; our marketing team will supply a rectangular PNG at 300x100px and include brand color hex codes.
- Written approval: email confirmation from an authorized stakeholder is fine — LegalOps will provide a point of contact and authority matrix.
- Evidence escrow: fine with the contract folder + HubSpot record approach.

Also attached: CloudVista_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf) and a SOC2 excerpt (SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf). Laura — can you confirm what the evidence bundle will look like and the filename convention for the contract folder?

Thanks,
Sanjay

Attachments: CloudVista_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf, 680KB); SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

Hi all — prepping the evidence bundle and naming convention. See checklist below and attached template. Once Sanjay confirms the asset and LegalOps confirms authority, we'll drop the packaged files into the HubSpot contract record and share a DocuSign attachment to the Order Form.

Evidence bundle checklist (to be uploaded to contract folder):
- Redacted_SOC2_excerpt.pdf (SOC2 summary + control scope)
- Approved_quote_email.pdf (PDF of the approval thread)
- Approved_asset (PNG and SVG) with filename: CloudVista_logo_approved_YYYYMMDD.png / .svg
- Publicity_spec.txt (fields: channel, run dates, quote text, attribution)
- Redwood_publicity_flow.pdf (internal checklist)

Filename convention: CloudVista_D-49821_evidence_20251015.zip (we will also attach the zip to the HubSpot record).

Attachments added here: Redwood_Publicity_Guidelines_v1.pdf (internal), Publicity_Bundle_Template.docx (docx, 12KB)

Next steps: Sanjay — please confirm the approved asset filenames and LegalOps confirm the signer list. After that, Kimberly, can you confirm the final Order Form language and I will attach everything and request countersignature via DocuSign.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketing Operations, Redwood Inference
